name: CloseButton
summary: The one close control for dialogs, toasts, banners, chips and drawers: a ghost icon button with the close icon and a default name.
useWhen: Closing a dialog, a drawer, a panel, a banner or a toast
Removing a chip or a filter, named for what it removes
Any close control, so every close looks and reads the same
avoidWhen: Cancelling a form or a task: say what happens with a Button (Cancel edit)
Deleting data: a close never deletes
A back step in a flow

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px in the default density. A ButtonGroup passes its size; this prop wins.

tone.description: Fixed: stamped so the shared Button.css draws it. Not a prop.

emphasis.description: Fixed: a close is always quiet. Not a prop; a ButtonGroup cannot change it.

shape.description: default takes radius.control (Desk draws it as a pill), pill is fully round, square takes radius.sm.

label.description: The accessible name (aria-label). Close, or إغلاق under an Arabic Theme. Name what closes when a screen has more than one (Close panel).

asChild.description: Renders the single child element, for example a link, as the control.

a11y.focus: In the tab order. A 2px ring on keyboard focus.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next control

a11y.announce: The label is the accessible name: Close by default, إغلاق under an Arabic Theme.
notes: Emphasis is always ghost and tone neutral; a ButtonGroup passes only size and shape.
The default name reads the lang of the nearest Theme, not a lang attribute on a plain element.
Dialog, Toast and Window draw their own close parts today; they can adopt CloseButton later (orders 1.6.1 and on).
At least 24 by 24 CSS px at xs.

Motion of round 3 (order 1.23, proposed, interaction close-turn): on hover, keyboard focus and press a round fill opens from the glyph (a circle clip on ::before) while the glyph turns a quarter turn on the snappy spring; a press pinches the glyph to scale.anticipate and it springs back on release. Hover only where the device can hover. Reduced motion: the fill shows whole at once, no turn, no pinch.

en.label: Close, or Close plus the thing: Close panel, Remove filter.

ar.label: إغلاق، أو إغلاق مع الشيء: إغلاق اللوحة.

angular.note: No asChild: a[dsCloseButton] is the link form. The default name follows the lang of the nearest dsTheme. tone and loading are inherited inputs of the base; leave them unset.

styles.desk: Ghost, a circle (Desk controls are pills).

mistakes.right: The default name, or Close plus the thing

mistakes.wrong: A close button that deletes the item
mistakes.right: A close only hides; deleting is a Button with tone danger
